reviews.cons:
-Incentive structure with too many clauses and old travelling and daily allowance structure (Like they are living in the era of 2013-14).They just follow their lesser ones in the industry instead of being trend setters because Cipla is one of biggest profitable Pharma company.
-Biased appraisal system and they don't care whether you have given an incredible performance that means all horses and donkeys are treated as equal at the time of appraisals.All people get +- 2-3% higher or lesser increments.

--Biased rewards and recognition programs without any transparency which is decided by marketing people for sales people.
--Foreign trips as per yearly performance are limited to nearby Asian countries only for 2-3 days only.No spouse and children are allowed like other companies.Very lesser known Pharma companies are doing much better out of country reward and recognition programs for their super achievers for 5-6 days unlike Cipla.
